text: グレンは　かざんの　ふんかで　もりあがって　できたって　きいたわ

structure.jp: かざんの　ふんかで
もりあがって　できたって
structure.en: rose up and was formed, (that's what)

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: できたって　きいた
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and comes after the words that were said or heard. できたって きいた = 'I heard that it was formed'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can show what caused something. ふんかで = 'because of an eruption'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: もりあがって　できた
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. もりあがって できた = 'rose up and was formed'.
